commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Adrian Cordero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' The current number of shots on goal is 4:3.
90+4' 3 - 1 An excellent first touch by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!

90+3' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Augusto Batalla guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
90+2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' A cross into the box from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

89' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but he misdirected his long-range shot as it went a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
87' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Adrian Cordero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Here is a change. Pacha is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Pathe Ciss.
85' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
84' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
83' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
80' 2 - 1 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top left corner.
80' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
80' Corner kick. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is ready to send the ball into the box.
79' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short.

79' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

78' A pass travels right across the box to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon denies him with a decent save.
77' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a chip pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is quickest to intercept the ball.
75' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
75' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alex Berenguer.
73' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
71' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
70' A substitution has been made. Jorge de Frutos goes off and Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
69' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
68' The resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes to nothing.
68' Augusto Batalla leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).

67' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
67' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
67' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
66' Chance! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
64' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) picks up a long through ball, but Augusto Batalla deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
63' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Gerard Gumbau is replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
63' Substitution. Pedro Diaz is replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz will be replaced by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
59' Here comes a substitution. Alvaro Djalo is given a rest as he is replaced by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao).
58' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Augusto Batalla no chance!
57' What was Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
57' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' The Ath Bilbao players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
56' Referee Adrian Cordero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Ath Bilbao. Let’s see what happens!
56' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
56' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
54' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
52' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
50' The attendance for today's match is 47584.
46' Ernesto Valverde has made a change at the break. Maroan Sannadi has come on in place of Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
46' The game is over for Unai Gomez. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
41' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
37' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the left side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Unai Simon who easily stops the effort.
36' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Rayo Vallecano!

35' There's a break in play and referee Adrian Cordero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Rayo Vallecano using VAR. This could be interesting!
35' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
33' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

30' What a chance that is! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the right post.
28' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

28' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
25' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
23' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' CHANCE! Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Unai Simon, who reacts superbly to stop him.

18' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
15' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.
13' Excellent touch by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
12' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
11' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
8' Gorka Guruzeta receives a sweet cross inside the box from Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
7' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
5' A pass from Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla and the move breaks down.
3' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged for offside.
1' What a huge chance for Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will referee today's match.
